Message from the Dean of Faculty:
(Dean's message illustrating a roadmap as well as focus on latest trends in different programs being executed in the Faculty and how the Faculty would produce quality graduates comparable to those of world-class institutions)

Mission of Faculty:
(Devise clear and explicit mission of Faculty)

Vision of Faculty:
(Devise clear and explicit vision of Faculty)

Goals and Targets of Faculty:
(Devise clear and explicit goals and targets of the Faculty. The targets must be SMART (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Realistic, and Time-framed)
Revision and Updation of Curriculum (Revised after 2 years = 2 marks; after 3 years = 1 mark)
Measures Undertaken to Improve the Quality of Teaching Following HEC QA Guidelines (Fully = 2 marks; Partially = 1 mark)
Teaching Effectiveness Index (Partial): a. Use of Innovative Technologies/Gadgets and Advanced Syllabus for Teaching (Full = 2 marks; Partial = 1 mark)
b. Student Learning Outcome (SLOs) Achievement (Average score more than 60% = 1 mark; more than 70% = 2 marks
c. Appraisal of Teaching Quality through Student Feedback - QEC (Average of the Faculty over 4 points = 2 marks; within 3.5-4 points = 1 mark)
Conferences/Symposia Organized at an International Level (One mark for each intl conf )
Conferences/Symposia Organized at National Level (0.5 mark for each conf)
Industrial Linkages Developed and Executed (One mark for each linkage developed and executed)
Increase in Enrollment over Last Year (5% increase =1 mark; 10% increase = 2 marks)
Student Retentation Rate (100% = 2 marks; 90-99% = 1 mark; 80-89% = 0.5 mark)
Faculty Social Responsibility and Brand Building (0.5 mark for each activity conducted)
Extension/Invited Lectures Delivered by Eminent Industrialists/Entrepreneurs/Scholars (6 lectures = 1 mark; 12 lecutres or more = 2 marks)
Number of International Academic Collaborations (4 Joint Ventures = 1 mark; 8 Ventures = 2 marks)
Contribution towards Overall Global Rankings (Significant contribution = 2 marks; Partial = 1 mark)
Contribution towards Subject Rankings (in top 100 = 2 marks; in top 200 = 1 mark)
Adherance to the UOL Main Strategic Plan (Siginifantly followed = 1 mark; Partially followed = 0.5 mark)          1
Number of Publications (Manuscripts - only Scopus indexed) (If 20 publications over the mandatory requirement = 1 mark; If 40 publications over the mandatory requirement = 2 marks; if 60 = 3 marks)
Number of Exotic (National/International) Grants Hunted (5 grants = 1.5 marks; 10 grants = 3 marks)
Elevation of Research and Scholarship Base (Effective base = 2 marks; Partially developed = 1 mark)
Books Published (one Book Published in a foreign publisher = 2 marks; two published = 4 marks. The Books published nationally will be given 50% weightage
Number of Patents Filed or Got Approved - National/International (1 National patent = 2 marks; 1 International Patent = 4 marks)
Increase in h-index of the Faculty (10% increase over last year = 1 mark; 20% increase = 2 marks
Number of Innovative Technologies or Protocols Developed and Commercialized (1 Technology developed = 0.5 mark, 1 Technology commercialized = 1 marks, and so on)
Mentoring System for Graduates Particularly for Postgraduates (monthly contact = 1 mark; fortnightly contact = 2 marks)
Accreditation Readiness for All Relevant Councils (Fully Ready = 2 marks; Partially Ready = 1 mark)
Student Enrolment Data (complete information i.e. students' adresses, parents details, etc. = 1 mark)
Faculty Profiles (Completely updated = 1 mark; not updated = 0 mark)
Teaching Workload Status Assessment (Complete = 1 mark)
Teaching Workload as Specified for Each Faculty Tier-wise (as per UOL Policy = 1 mark; not as per UOL Policy = 0 mark)
Availability and Future Requirement of Infrastructure and Logistics (Developed = 1 mark; Not Developed = 0 mark))
Novelty and Importance of Postgraduate Research being Carried-out (Up to the mark = 1 mark; unsatisfactory = 0 mark)
Number of New Programs Launched (One mark for each)
Faculty and Staff Attendance (Monitored regularly = 2 marks; not monitored = 0 mark)
Statutory Bodies' Rules, Regulations,  and Policies implemented (Yes = 2 marks; Partial Implementation =1 mark)
Board of Faculty Meetings Convened (12 Meetings per annum = 2 marks; 6 meetings per annum = 1)
Alumni Engagement (Annual meetings of all departments = 1 mark; 6 monthly meetings of all departments = 2 marks)
Does the Faculty have a well-established student mentoring system? (Full-fledged system = 2 marks; Partial system = 1 mark)
Graduate Employability Rate (5-10% = 0.5 mark; 10-20% = 1 mark; over 20% = 2)
Student Advising Services Established (in all departments = 2 marks; Partial = 1 mark)
Effectiveness of Internships Mutually Developed and Conducted (0.5 mark for each)
Extra-Curricular Activities (0.1 mark for each)
Student Satisfaction Index - QEC (over 4 points = 2 marks; within 3.5-4 = 1 mark)
Faculty Satisfaction Index - Rector through annual climate survey (over 4 points = 2 marks; within 3.5-4 = 1 mark)
Faculty and Staff Turnover rate (Less than 5% = 2 marks; Less than 10% = 1 mark)
Faculty/Staff Trainings (0.5 mark for each training)
Retension of High-Performing Faculty (100% = 1 mark)
Different Academic/Administrative Meetings (Full attendance = 1 mark; Partial attendance = 0.5 mark)
Close Liaison with the Regulatory Bodies (Effective liaison = 1 mark; Poor liaison = 0 mark)
Deliverance Level and Future Development Plans for the Faculty Uplift (To be assessed by the Rector/Chairman)
Assessment of the Level of Leadership and Management of the Dean as compared with his Contemporaries (To be assessed by the Rector/Chairman)
